sources.title: moona_hoshinova_(1st_costume)
sources.excerpt:
The default costume of [[hololive Indonesia|hololive ID]]'s [[Moona Hoshinova]]. 
 
It consists of a [[black choker]], a [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[white jacket]] worn [[off shoulder]] and held with a [[black belt]], worn over a [[crop top|cropped]] [[black shirt|black]] [[skin tight]] [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[collared halterneck|collared]] [[halter shirt|halter]] [[cropped shirt|shirt]] with a [[contrast collar|white]] [[wing collar|wing]] [[collared shirt|collar]] and a [[blue bowtie]] with a [[star brooch]], a pair of [[black shorts|black]] [[short shorts]], and [[black boots|black]] [[high heel boots|high-heel]] [[thigh boots]]. She also has a [[single earring|single]] [[hoop earrings|hoop earring]] on her left ear.

sources.title: moona_hoshinova_(1st_costume)
sources.excerpt:
The default costume for [[hololive Indonesia]]'s [[Moona Hoshinova]]. 
 
It consists of a [[black choker]], a [[white jacket]] with [[long sleeves]] which she wears [[off shoulder]], worn over a [[skin tight]] [[crop top|cropped]] [[black shirt]] [[cropped_shirt|shirt]] with a [[wing_collar|wing]] [[collared_shirt|collar]] and a [[blue bowtie]] with a [[star brooch]], a pair of [[black shorts|black]] [[short shorts]], [[black footwear|black]] [[thigh boots|thigh]] [[high heel boots]]. She also has a [[single earring|single]] [[hoop earrings|hoop earring]] on her left ear.

profiles.notes: Official first costume; props, weapons, lore and non-outfit metadata excluded. Features link to the site-specific Danbooru excerpt; Gelbooru is retained as an independent captured source.
